name: SciEats (Nonprofit Eatery)
notes: All 3 photos were legible menus/menu flyers: (1) All Day Menu card, (2) Brunch menu card, (3) September promotional flyer announcing new entrees at $12.99, plus vegan mung specials and a Gujarati thali meal.

dishes.name: Chicken Lollipop
dishes.description: Juicy, spice-marinated chicken drumettes shaped into lollipops and baked or fried, high in lean protein

dishes.name: Beef Kebab
dishes.description: Juicy, spice-marinated grilled ground beef kabab on the stick

dishes.name: Chicken Kebab
dishes.description: Juicy, spice-marinated grilled chicken on the stick

dishes.name: Paneer Kebab
dishes.description: Juicy, spice-marinated grilled paneer on the stick

dishes.name: Fermented Lentil Pops
dishes.description: Vegan friendly crispy, savory protein and fiber-rich balls. Cholesterol free, gut friendly, filled with probiotics.

dishes.name: Whole Wheat Roti
dishes.description: Twist to classic Indian roti - Fermentation adds unique flavor and probiotic benefits making it gut friendly and immune supportive.

dishes.name: Carrot Halwa
dishes.description: A warm, fiber-rich Indian dessert made with slow-cooked carrots, milk, and nuts.

dishes.name: Flan
dishes.description: Silky, protein-rich caramel custard with a creamy texture and delicate sweetness. A light yet indulgent classic.

dishes.name: Berry Punch
dishes.description: Mixed berries infused with fresh mint - rich in antioxidants, vitamins and fiber.

dishes.name: Mango Lassi
dishes.description: Naturally sweet and tangy drink, rich in vitamins and protein. Mango blended with house-made yogurt into a smooth drink.

dishes.name: Caramel Lemonade
dishes.description: Lemonade with a twist of caramelized sugar meets zesty lemon. Made from real lemon, rich in natural Vitamin C

dishes.name: Special Chai
dishes.description: Warm black tea, ginger, mint, cardamom, milk and sugar boiled to perfection for a flavor and taste.

dishes.name: Malva Pudding
dishes.description: Rich in flavor, moist buttery South African pudding with apricot jam.

dishes.name: Crème Brulé
dishes.description: Protein rich vanilla custard with a crispy, caramelized sugar top

dishes.name: Ras Malai
dishes.description: Delicate, protein- and calcium-rich cheese patties soaked in fragrant cardamom-infused sweet milk. A soft, melt-in-your-mouth treat.

dishes.name: Lentil Pancakes
dishes.description: Gluten-free Pancakes made from fermented lentils. Choose sweet (banana, no added sugar) or savory (herbs & spices).

dishes.name: Russian Pancakes
dishes.description: Thin, Russian style pancakes made with flour, milk whey, topped with fruit compote or honey.

dishes.name: Omelet
dishes.description: Two-egg omelet with seasonal vegetables, herbs and cheese.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
dishes.description: Poached eggs in a spicy tomato and bell pepper sauce with garlic and cumin.

dishes.name: Yogurt with Fruits
dishes.description: Homemade creamy yogurt topped with seasonal fruits, nuts, granola and a drizzle of honey.

dishes.name: Hot Chocolate
dishes.description: Low sugar cocoa infused milk

dishes.name: House Blend Coffee
dishes.description: Freshly ground and brewed in-house, our smooth, aromatic coffee blend is bold, balanced, and crafted for daily comfort.

dishes.name: Butter Chicken
dishes.description: Tender chicken in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce. North Indian richness at its best.

dishes.name: Gujarati Meal
dishes.description: A balanced, home-style meal packed with love and tradition: Okra or Aloo Gobi, Mung Dal, Steamed Rice + Soft Roti, Gajar Halwa/Rice Pudding/Kheer, House-made Buttermilk.
